svg.title: Installation wiring: Nilight panel rockers and LED light circuits to the Waveshare ESP32-S3-POE-ETH-8DI-8RO
svg.desc: The trailer harness grey wires stay on their existing butt splices feeding the panel voltmeter. The red feed is extended to relay CH1 COM with a jumper to CH2 COM, and optionally through a 2 A inline fuse to the board supply. The two grey LED light wires move from the old switch load tabs to CH1 NO and CH2 NO. The four BANDC rockers connect as dry contacts to DGND and DI1 to DI8. The old red and black daisy chains to the switch positions are removed.
svg.text: Installation wiring as built: Nilight panel → Waveshare ESP32-S3-POE-ETH-8DI-8RO (LED lights on CH1 / CH2)
Pull the WFCO fuse that feeds the panel first (voltmeter goes dark) and verify dead. Rockers 1–2 run the lights, 3–4 are spares; the voltmeter keeps its original feed and ground.
Waveshare ESP32-S3-POE-ETH-8DI-8RO — in the cabinet next to the panel
COM = middle terminal. NO = the outer one that is
OPEN to COM with the relay off: meter it.
Left/right flips with how the board is mounted.
BANDC rockers in the four openings; old red/black
lamp chains to the switch positions removed and capped
feed extension — *10 A fuse only if the wire is thinner than the existing feed; as built: no inline fuses fitted
grey light wires extended to the cabinet

casita / modifications/06-smart-dc-switches / images/install-wiring.svg — 2026-10-23. As built 2026-10-23: two LED light circuits on CH1/CH2 (≤10 A / 30 V DC); board mounted labels-down. Not a schematic of the WFCO side.
